prompt: Write a hook for the new Swap CTA on the transmuter page. It should take an input asset denom, output asset denom, and amount, then execute a transmuter swap. Put it in components/Transmuter/hooks/useTransmuterSwap.ts

assertions.text: Uses useQuery for message building (not useMutation)
Imports and calls useSimulateAndBroadcast (no custom simulation)
Returns { action, msgs } matching codebase convention
Has enabled gates on both message query and simulation
Invalidates cache on success via queryClient.invalidateQueries with targeted prefixes
Query keys use only primitives (no objects)
